career_overview.short_description: Extract actionable knowledge from complex data using applied statistics, machine learning algorithms, and predictive modeling.
responsibilities: Perform comprehensive exploratory data analysis (EDA) and data cleansing on raw datasets
Apply statistical hypothesis testing, probability distributions, and A/B test methodologies
Engineer informative features and train supervised and unsupervised machine learning models
Evaluate model performance rigorously using cross-validation and error diagnostics
Explain model predictions using interpretability techniques and communicate findings clearly
representative_work: An end-to-end data science project including data wrangling, exploratory visualizations, statistical hypothesis testing, machine learning model training, cross-validation evaluation, and SHAP interpretability explanations.
core_skills: Hypothesis testing and A/B experimental design

roadmap.title: Data Scientist: beginner foundations and starter project
roadmap.intended_learner: Motivated beginner; basic computer literacy assumed, with no prior professional experience.
roadmap.starting_requirements: Computer, internet access, text editor, terminal and modern browser. Most tasks use free software or local runtimes.
roadmap.final_outcome: An end-to-end data science project including data wrangling, exploratory visualizations, statistical hypothesis testing, machine learning model training, cross-validation evaluation, and SHAP interpretability explanations.
